adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with a case-sensitive comparison: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. Inputs (`guests`) are not normalized (no `.toLowerCase()`), and the schema only validates email format. Therefore an existing attendee `bob@x.com` would not match an added guest `Bob@x.com`, allowing a duplicate attendee row to be created via `attendees.createMany`, and downstream calendar/email logic would treat it as an additional invitee.
